item.title: Bernard-Henri Lévy: The Israel-UAE Deal Shows Real Promise
item.description: Bernard-Henri Lévy on the Israel-UAE deal: Isn’t peace—true peace—the surest route to the most enduring security for the Middle East?

item.title: The Laboratories of Financial Secrecy - The American Interest
item.description: Every day that goes by more dirty money flows through the United States, but the American people are in control of the tap. If they choose, they can switch it off.

item.title: Is There a Recipe for Democratic Success? - The American Interest
item.description: The mixed successes of transitions from communism in Central and Eastern Europe suggest that countries that cleanly broke with the past enjoyed greater success with reforms.

item.title: Why We Need Better Infrastructure Now - The American Interest
item.description: TAI Publisher Charles Davidson sat down with the former mayor of Miami Manny Diaz to talk about why America is exceptionally bad among Western democracies when it comes to investing in infrastructure.

item.title: Defeating the Hydra - The American Interest
item.description: Can we imagine a world where greed is not the main driver of events? If liberal democracy is to survive, we have to try.

item.title: The Financial Infrastructure of Corruption - The American Interest
item.description: The parallels between “tax optimization” and “corruption” are so strong because they rely on the same mechanisms to get the job done.

item.title: How Chinese Corruption Spreads Misery Abroad - The American Interest
item.description: Chinese mega-projects, both at home and abroad, are not only a vehicle for corruption. They are a deadly public hazard.

item.title: To Cure What Ails Us - The American Interest
item.description: Our polarization runs deep. How do we get our politics to a better place after Trump is gone?

item.title: A Peace Prize for Ali Khamenei? - The American Interest
item.description: Trump was the midwife of the Abraham Accords. The father was Ali Khamenei, the “Supreme Leader” of Iran, whose imperial ambitions started to force Arabs and Israelis into a historic realignment decades ago.
